basic_info.description: Bay view studio with a generously sized sleeping alcove. Step inside this 8th floor oasis to a spacious kitchen with abundant cabinet and counter space, and modern stainless-steel appliances.  Enjoy watching the ships pass by from the comfort of your own couch. An updated bathroom and 2 closets complete this home. Living here, though, your building is also part of your home. Experience full-service living with a 24/7 attended front desk, sauna, two elevators, a rental guest suite, club room with full kitchen and bar area, landscaped interior courtyard, 2 free laundry rooms, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and on-site manager.  There is 1 car assigned parking in the garage below - just an elevator ride away - that also boasts free bike storage for residents. Storage spaces can be rented from the HOA on an as available basis.   With an impressive 91 Walk Score, indulge in the convenience of being close to an array of dining, shopping & entertainment options. Take a leisurely stroll down to Pier 29 to watch the cruise ships come in, or just spot the sailboats on the bay. Enjoy the food trucks at Levi Plaza.  You're just steps away from the Bay Club, North Beach, The Embarcadero, Ferry Building, Coit Tower, and Pioneer Park to name just a few.
